title: Invoices
description: Every invoice across your members and companies — paid, unpaid, and drafts in one ledger.
askOwnerOrAdmin: Ask a space owner or admin to manage invoices.

emptyState.noInvoicesDesc: Raise one manually, or generate this month's invoices for members on auto-billing.

picker.title: New invoice
picker.description: Pick the member to bill, or start a manual invoice.

actions.noEmailDesc: Add a contact email to the member profile before sending invoices.
actions.voidDialogDesc: The invoice will be marked as void and become read-only. The invoice number is preserved for your records and won't be reused.

batch.title: Generate pending invoices
batch.description: Creates a draft invoice for every member with auto-invoicing turned on, using their active monthly contract for the cycle window and total. You'll review and send each draft from the member's invoice list.
batch.noOptedIn: No members have auto-invoicing turned on yet.
batch.noOptedInHint: Open a member's billing details and switch it on to include them here.
batch.createdDesc: Review and send them from each member.
batch.alreadyCoveredDesc: Nothing new to invoice — every opted-in member was already covered.

preview.loadFailed: Couldn't load this invoice. Please try again.

billTo.title: Bill to
billTo.prefilledHelp: Prefilled from the member profile. Edits here stay on this invoice — save the member's company details in their profile to avoid re-typing.
billTo.manualHelp: Manual invoice — type the recipient details below. Nothing is saved to a member profile.

numberAndDates.title: Number & dates
numberAndDates.collisionSuffixed: <1>{{number}}</1> is already taken by another (non-void) invoice — this draft will save as <3>{{effective}}</3>. Void or delete the conflicting one if you need the bare number.
numberAndDates.overridden: Will save as <1>{{number}}</1>. Voided invoices' numbers are reusable.
numberAndDates.autoSequence: From the org sequence. Edit to override for this invoice — voided numbers can be reused as-is.

planGeneration.title: Generate from plan
planGeneration.description: Split the billing period by calendar month and prorate partial months.
planGeneration.noPlans: No active monthly desk, virtual-office, or private-office plan with a price was found. You can still enter invoice lines manually.
planGeneration.datesLimited: Dates were limited to the active plan term: {{period}}.
planGeneration.failedDesc: Check the selected plan and billing dates.

unlinkedCharges.title: Unlinked charges
unlinkedCharges.description: Existing Charges for this member that aren't on any invoice yet — add one to fold it into this invoice instead of retyping it.
unlinkedCharges.empty: No unlinked Charges for this member.
unlinkedCharges.unlinkedWarningTitle: Invoice saved, but some charges were not linked
unlinkedCharges.unlinkedWarningDesc: {{failedCount}} of {{totalCount}} selected charge(s) could not be attached to the invoice. Check with Alex before sending it — an unlinked charge amount may otherwise be posted again.

payment.title: Payment
payment.bankDetailsConfigured: Bank details from Organization → Billing are included automatically on the PDF footer.
payment.bankDetailsMissing: Tip: add bank details in Settings → Organization → Billing so they appear on every invoice.

notes.title: Notes
notes.placeholder: Thank-you message, payment terms, reference number...

preview.emptyPrompt: Enter a recipient name to generate an invoice preview.

validation.startBeforeEnd: Billing period start must be on or before the end date.
validation.addAtLeastOneLine: Add at least one line with a description.
validation.qtyGreaterThanZero: quantity must be greater than zero

memberDialog.descInvoices_other: {{count}} invoices — send, download, or mark as paid.
memberDialog.descNoInvoices: No invoices yet. Create the first one below.
